metadata.title: SME-FraudGuard System Test Cases
metadata.executionNote: Designed cases. No case has been executed by this document-authoring task. Actual results, evidence, tester and run date are recorded only after execution.
metadata.traceNote: UC/BR/CR baseline retained; current SRS section 3 references identify design scope. This is a designed catalogue, not executed coverage.
metadata.dataNote: Transaction fields, types and date/time conversion remain generic and workspace-configured in product documentation. TEST-MAP-A is explicitly synthetic test configuration, not a global contract.

priorities.P1: Authorization, tenant isolation, accepted-data integrity, payment/case-entitlement gates or sensitive-data protection.
priorities.P2: Main functional flows and controlled error handling.

cases.title: Sign in as Platform Admin
cases.preconditions: A provisioned Platform Admin account exists; its initial password change is complete.
steps: Open the appropriate portal sign-in page.
Enter the provisioned account identifier and its runtime test password.
Submit sign-in and open the role's permitted home view.
expected: Authentication succeeds and the permitted role/workspace context is displayed.
The session can perform permitted operations only; no production content is exposed merely by platform-role login.

cases.title: Reject invalid credentials without identifying an account
cases.preconditions: A known provisioned account exists and the tester is signed out.
steps: Attempt sign-in with the known identifier and an incorrect runtime password.
Attempt sign-in with a nonexistent test identifier.
Compare user-visible errors and attempt a protected operation after each failure.
expected: Both attempts fail without creating an authenticated session.
Errors do not disclose whether an account exists or return protected account information.

cases.title: Require the initial password change
cases.preconditions: A provisioned account has not completed its required initial password change.
steps: Sign in with the initial runtime credentials.
Attempt a normal role operation through the portal.
Repeat the protected operation directly through the approved server interface.
expected: Only the required password-setup flow is available.
Other protected operations are rejected until the password change succeeds.

cases.title: Complete the initial password change
cases.preconditions: The account is restricted to first-login setup; a runtime password satisfying the configured policy is available.
steps: Submit the required password change.
Check the saved completion state.
Perform an otherwise authorized role operation.
expected: The new password is saved using protected credential storage.
The initial-setup restriction is removed and permitted work becomes available.

cases.title: Reject an empty password change without unlocking setup
cases.preconditions: The account is in required first-login setup.
steps: Leave the required new-password value empty and submit.
Inspect the validation response.
Try a normal protected operation.
expected: Validation rejects the missing value without changing the stored credential.
The first-login restriction remains in force.

cases.title: Reject an unauthenticated protected request
cases.preconditions: No portal session or integration credential is supplied.
steps: Request a protected workspace list or detail through the approved interface.
Attempt a protected update without signing in.
expected: Authentication is required for each protected request.
No protected record is returned or changed.

cases.title: Reject an expired or otherwise invalid session
cases.preconditions: A test session that is no longer valid is available.
steps: Use the invalid session to request a protected view.
Repeat a previously permitted state-changing request.
expected: Both requests require authentication again.
The server does not accept a cached browser role as authentication.

cases.title: End the current session on logout
cases.preconditions: OP-A has a valid session and accepted workspace records exist.
steps: Sign out.
Replay a protected request using the ended session.
Sign in again and inspect permitted historical records.
expected: The ended session no longer authorizes protected requests.
Logging out does not delete workspace records or history.

cases.title: Keep the internal login identifier distinct from contact email
cases.preconditions: A provisioned account has a documented internal login identifier and a different test contact address.
steps: Sign in using the provisioned identifier.
Inspect the account's permitted profile/contact information.
Check that changing a contact field through an authorized operation does not grant another workspace identity.
expected: The provisioned login identity and contact address remain distinct concepts.
Workspace access follows the authenticated account, not the address suffix.

cases.title: Keep credentials out of responses and logs
cases.preconditions: An isolated test environment provides authorized response/log inspection; credentials are generated at runtime.
steps: Sign in and perform a password change.
Inspect permitted responses, application logs and audit records.
Search for the actual runtime password and full session secret in output.
expected: Passwords and full authentication secrets are not returned or logged.
Auditing retains only permitted identity/action metadata.

cases.title: Reject cross-workspace object access
cases.preconditions: A and B contain distinguishable transactions/reports; OP-A is signed in.
steps: Request an authorized A record.
Substitute a B object reference on direct detail/download/update requests.
Repeat with a workspace filter supplied by the caller.
expected: The authorized A operation succeeds.
B data is not returned, changed or revealed by a more specific existence message.

cases.title: Do not trust an edited browser role or workspace
cases.preconditions: A restricted enterprise account is signed in; its browser state can be inspected in the isolated test environment.
steps: Alter only client-side role/workspace/plan display state.
Attempt an Operator-only case action and a B-scope lookup directly.
expected: Server-side identity, permissions and entitlements remain authoritative.
The changed browser state grants no additional action or data access.

cases.title: Platform Admin cannot read enterprise production data
cases.preconditions: PA is authenticated; workspace A has production transactions, sensitive fields and investigation reports.
steps: Attempt production transaction/detail/report retrieval.
Attempt explicit sensitive-field disclosure through the approved protected interface.
expected: The requests are denied without returning production contents or sensitive plaintext.
Permitted platform/onboarding metadata remains separately accessible.

cases.title: Implementation Staff cannot read enterprise production data
cases.preconditions: STAFF-A is authenticated; workspace A has production transactions, sensitive fields and investigation reports.
steps: Attempt production transaction/detail/report retrieval.
Attempt explicit sensitive-field disclosure through the approved protected interface.
expected: The requests are denied without returning production contents or sensitive plaintext.
Permitted platform/onboarding metadata remains separately accessible.

cases.title: Limit Staff operations to current assignments
cases.preconditions: STAFF-A is assigned to A and not B.
steps: Open A onboarding/configuration and perform an authorized test action.
Substitute B in configuration, sample-test and key-issuance requests.
expected: Assigned-workspace actions are permitted.
Unassigned-workspace actions are rejected without changing B.

cases.title: Apply a Staff reassignment to later requests
cases.preconditions: STAFF-A currently handles A; another platform Staff account exists.
steps: Reassign A through Platform Admin.
Using the old Staff session, attempt another A configuration/test/key operation.
Use the newly assigned Staff account for an authorized A onboarding action.
expected: Later requests by the old assignee no longer gain assignment-based access.
The new assignee receives only the documented onboarding scope; production data remains restricted.

cases.title: Prevent enterprise users from configuring mappings/rules
cases.preconditions: SA-A, OP-A and INV-A1 are provisioned enterprise accounts.
steps: For each enterprise role, attempt direct mapping and rule changes.
Inspect configuration and change history afterwards.
expected: All unauthorized configuration attempts are denied.
The active configuration and its history are not changed by those attempts.

cases.title: Restrict Investigator to assigned-case information
cases.preconditions: INV-A1 is assigned CASE-A1; another A case and a B case are not assigned to it.
steps: Read and update permitted findings for CASE-A1.
Request the unassigned A case, its transaction/report and sensitive-field action.
Repeat with the B case.
expected: Assigned-case work is allowed within field permission.
Unassigned or other-workspace content and actions are denied.

cases.title: Remove old Investigator access after reassignment
cases.preconditions: INV-A1 is assigned the case; INV-A2 is another Investigator in A.
steps: Operator reassigns the case to INV-A2.
INV-A1 requests fresh case/report/field access with its existing session.
INV-A2 opens the assigned case.
expected: INV-A1 no longer obtains assignment-based access on later requests.
INV-A2 can perform only the permitted assigned-case operations.
Assignment history is retained.

cases.title: Do not grant case-management authority to Investigator
cases.preconditions: INV-A1 has an assigned case and a valid session.
steps: Attempt to open a case, assign/reassign a case and confirm a final conclusion using Investigator credentials.
expected: All three actions are denied.
Existing case assignment and final conclusion are unchanged.

cases.title: Separate SME Admin reporting from investigation handling
cases.preconditions: SA-A is signed in and A has permitted investigation reports.
steps: Read a permitted enterprise report.
Attempt to open a case, save investigation findings, submit an investigation report and confirm a conclusion.
expected: Permitted report viewing succeeds.
Investigation-handling actions are denied for SME Admin.

cases.title: Reject unauthorized production file import
cases.preconditions: A is active; Staff and Investigator accounts exist.
steps: Attempt production import as Staff and as Investigator.
Inspect production/import records.
expected: Neither role can import production transactions.
No production transaction or detection is created by the denied attempts.

cases.title: Provision one enterprise workspace and SME Admin
cases.preconditions: PA is authenticated; the synthetic enterprise has no workspace.
steps: Create the enterprise/workspace and provision its SME Admin account.
Assign the initial plan.
Inspect the provisioned account, workspace and permitted administrative history.
expected: One workspace and one initial SME Admin identity are provisioned for that enterprise.
The account contact field is distinct from its login identity.
Production remains unavailable until the handover/activation prerequisites are met.

cases.title: Prevent a second workspace for the same enterprise
cases.preconditions: The synthetic enterprise already has its workspace.
steps: Request another workspace for the same enterprise reference.
Repeat the creation request concurrently or as a safe retry.
expected: The enterprise still has one workspace.
The system rejects the duplicate creation or returns the existing authorized result without creating a second workspace.

cases.title: Update customer metadata while retaining history
cases.preconditions: A has existing onboarding, transaction and case history; PA can edit permitted customer metadata.
steps: Update a permitted enterprise contact/description field.
Inspect workspace identity and retained business-history references.
expected: The authorized metadata update is saved and attributable.
Existing production/case history is preserved; PA gains no content-reading rights.

cases.title: Assign a Staff member and expose onboarding metadata
cases.preconditions: PA and a Staff account exist; A is in onboarding.
steps: Assign Staff to A.
Open the Staff's assigned-workspace view.
Review the visible assignment and onboarding information.
expected: The current assignment is saved and visible to the assigned Staff.
Only permitted implementation metadata is exposed.

cases.title: SME Admin provisions an enterprise Operator
cases.preconditions: SA-A is authenticated; the proposed member identifier is unused in A.
steps: Create a member using a permitted Operator role within A.
Sign in as that member using runtime setup credentials.
Inspect the resulting role and workspace scope.
expected: The member belongs to A and the selected permitted enterprise role.
Its first-login and access restrictions are enforced.

cases.title: SME Admin provisions an enterprise Investigator
cases.preconditions: SA-A is authenticated; the proposed member identifier is unused in A.
steps: Create a member using a permitted Investigator role within A.
Sign in as that member using runtime setup credentials.
Inspect the resulting role and workspace scope.
expected: The member belongs to A and the selected permitted enterprise role.
Its first-login and access restrictions are enforced.

cases.title: Reject granting a platform role through enterprise member management
cases.preconditions: SA-A can manage enterprise members.
steps: Attempt to set a member role to Platform Admin or Implementation Staff through the protected interface.
expected: The change is rejected.
No enterprise account receives a platform role or platform scope.

cases.title: Keep member changes inside the administering workspace
cases.preconditions: SA-A is authenticated; a distinguishable B member exists.
steps: Substitute B's member reference during a member update/removal request.
expected: The request cannot change B's member.
The response does not expose B account data.

cases.title: Preserve attribution after a permitted member removal
cases.preconditions: A removable test member has historical actions; the selected removal is allowed by the approved account lifecycle policy.
steps: Perform the authorized member removal/deactivation.
Inspect historical action attribution and retained business records using an authorized actor.
Try a fresh protected request using the removed member's previous access.
expected: Required history/references remain intelligible and retained.
The member cannot retain access that the lifecycle operation has removed.
No accepted transaction or case report is cascade-deleted.

cases.title: Submit specifications without activating production
cases.preconditions: SA-A has completed initial password setup and A is in onboarding. Configuration edits are candidate drafts; production uses only an explicitly applied version.
steps: Upload the permitted business/data specification document.
Review its submission and onboarding progress.
Attempt production import before handover/activation.
expected: The specification is retained for human review and progress is visible.
No automatic rule extraction or workspace activation occurs.
Production import remains blocked.

cases.title: Allow assigned Staff/Platform Admin to submit received specifications
cases.preconditions: An enterprise specification was received through an approved outside channel; PA or the assigned Staff is authenticated. Configuration edits are candidate drafts; production uses only an explicitly applied version.
steps: Submit the specification to A through the permitted onboarding action.
Inspect the recorded responsible actor and retained document.
expected: The document is associated with A and its submission identity/time are retained.
It is not treated as a production transaction file.

cases.title: Allow SME Admin to inspect its onboarding progress
cases.preconditions: A has recorded implementation steps/comments and SA-A is authenticated. Configuration edits are candidate drafts; production uses only an explicitly applied version.
steps: Open onboarding progress.
Review assigned Staff and outstanding prerequisites.
Inspect the workspace activation control.
expected: Only A's permitted progress/comments are displayed.
Readiness, approval and activation remain distinguishable; unfulfilled prerequisites are shown clearly.

cases.title: Run a valid sample test without production side effects
cases.preconditions: STAFF-A is assigned to A; TEST-MAP-A and test rules are configured. Configuration edits are candidate drafts; production uses only an explicitly applied version.
steps: Record current production transaction/alert/case/statistic counts.
Run a JSON or file sample through mapping, validation and rules.
Inspect test output, run metadata and production counts.
expected: The sample reports validation/rule results under the selected test configuration.
Production transactions, alerts, cases, feedback and dashboard counts do not change.
Retained test metadata excludes sample contents.

cases.title: Report sample validation errors without bypassing validation
cases.preconditions: STAFF-A is assigned and the synthetic test mapping is configured. Configuration edits are candidate drafts; production uses only an explicitly applied version.
steps: Run a sample containing a missing required value, a wrong type and valid values.
Inspect sample-specific errors and results.
expected: Invalid sample records are identified and are not evaluated as valid transactions.
Useful permitted field/row references are reported without exposing sensitive values.
No production effects occur.

cases.title: Do not activate or approve handover merely because testing succeeds
cases.preconditions: A has a successful sample-test result but readiness/approval/activation have not all occurred. Configuration edits are candidate drafts; production uses only an explicitly applied version.
steps: Complete the sample test.
Inspect readiness/approval/activation records and try a production submission.
expected: A test result does not create a human readiness decision, approval or activation.
Production remains blocked.

cases.title: Staff records implementation readiness
cases.preconditions: Assigned Staff has reviewed the confirmed configuration and sample-test results. Configuration edits are candidate drafts; production uses only an explicitly applied version. Initial configuration has been explicitly applied before readiness confirmation.
steps: Confirm implementation readiness with permitted comments.
Review the retained decision and next action.
expected: Staff identity, time and readiness/comments are retained.
The workspace awaits Platform Admin approval; production and the onboarding Subscription term do not start.

cases.title: Platform Admin approves a ready workspace
cases.preconditions: Staff readiness is recorded for A; PA is authenticated. Configuration edits are candidate drafts; production uses only an explicitly applied version.
steps: Review onboarding readiness.
Approve handover.
Inspect approval history and production availability.
expected: The approval decision is retained.
SME Admin can proceed to activation; approval alone does not enable production or start the onboarding term.

cases.title: Return handover work with comments
cases.preconditions: A has been submitted for handover review. Configuration edits are candidate drafts; production uses only an explicitly applied version.
steps: Return the handover for further work with a reason/comment.
Read the progress as assigned Staff and SME Admin.
Try SME activation without the current required approval.
expected: The return and comments remain in history and further work is visible.
Activation is not permitted without the required approval.

cases.title: Reject approval/activation that bypasses readiness
cases.preconditions: A has no Staff readiness confirmation. Configuration edits are candidate drafts; production uses only an explicitly applied version.
steps: Attempt handover approval through the protected interface without the readiness prerequisite.
Attempt SME activation afterwards.
expected: The prerequisite checks prevent the bypass.
A remains non-operational and no onboarding Subscription term starts.

cases.title: Reject SME activation before Platform Admin approval
cases.preconditions: Staff readiness exists but handover has not been approved. Configuration edits are candidate drafts; production uses only an explicitly applied version.
steps: Sign in as SA-A and request activation directly.
expected: Activation is rejected.
Production remains unavailable and no Subscription start is recorded.

cases.title: Activate the approved workspace and start its initial Subscription
cases.preconditions: Staff readiness and Platform Admin approval exist; A has an initial Subscription granted during onboarding. Configuration edits are candidate drafts; production uses only an explicitly applied version.
steps: Record the authoritative activation time.
Activate A as SA-A.
Inspect operational availability and Subscription validity.
expected: A becomes operational after the authorized activation.
The initial Subscription starts at activation rather than workspace creation/initial grant.
The responsible actor and activation history are retained.

cases.title: Do not restart an initial Subscription on a repeated activation request
cases.preconditions: A has already been activated and its initial term is recorded. Configuration edits are candidate drafts; production uses only an explicitly applied version.
steps: Repeat the activation request and issue concurrent equivalent requests.
Compare activation and Subscription start/expiry records.
expected: The existing successful activation is preserved or the repeated action is rejected.
No second activation effect or fresh term is granted.

cases.title: Clean up temporary samples while retaining onboarding documents
cases.preconditions: An onboarding document is retained; a sample test can be completed and another can be interrupted. Configuration edits are candidate drafts; production uses only an explicitly applied version.
steps: Run one sample test to completion and interrupt another.
Perform the documented failure-recovery cleanup.
Inspect temporary artifacts, retained run metadata and the onboarding document.
expected: Temporary sample contents are removed under the cleanup lifecycle, including abandoned artifacts.
Permitted metadata remains without raw sample contents.
The retained specification document is not deleted as a temporary sample.

cases.title: Issue a workspace submission key as Platform Admin
cases.preconditions: A exists; PA has issuance permission for A.
steps: Issue a new A key.
Observe its one-time disclosure and retained key metadata.
Open the key again after leaving the issuance result.
expected: The new full value is disclosed once for secure delivery.
Subsequent views do not retrieve the old full secret.
The key is bound to A and submission rights.

cases.title: Issue a workspace submission key as assigned Staff
cases.preconditions: A exists; STAFF-A has issuance permission for A.
steps: Issue a new A key.
Observe its one-time disclosure and retained key metadata.
Open the key again after leaving the issuance result.
expected: The new full value is disclosed once for secure delivery.
Subsequent views do not retrieve the old full secret.
The key is bound to A and submission rights.

cases.title: Do not issue keys through SME Admin privileges
cases.preconditions: SA-A is authenticated.
steps: Attempt the key-issuance operation directly as SME Admin.
expected: Issuance is denied and no new key is created.
SME Admin retains only the agreed receiving/disabling responsibilities.

cases.title: Limit an integration key to submission scope
cases.preconditions: An active A integration key exists; A is operational.
steps: Submit an otherwise valid A transaction using the key.
Use the same key to request transaction reading, enterprise reports and case actions.
expected: The permitted submission is accepted.
Reading/reporting/investigation operations are denied for the submission key.

cases.title: Reject a key bound to a different workspace
cases.preconditions: An A key exists and B is operational.
steps: Attempt to submit to B with A's key, including a caller-supplied B workspace value.
Inspect B's transaction/attempt records.
expected: The request cannot establish B scope.
No unauthorized B production transaction or detection is created.

cases.title: Disable an authorized workspace key as PA
cases.preconditions: PA has the agreed disabling permission; a valid A key and an accepted A transaction exist.
steps: Disable the A key.
Send a fresh valid transaction using the disabled key.
Inspect the earlier accepted transaction and administrative history.
expected: Subsequent submissions using the disabled key are rejected.
Previously accepted records remain retained.
The disabling identity/time/outcome are recorded.

cases.title: Disable an authorized workspace key as STAFF-A
cases.preconditions: STAFF-A has the agreed disabling permission; a valid A key and an accepted A transaction exist.
steps: Disable the A key.
Send a fresh valid transaction using the disabled key.
Inspect the earlier accepted transaction and administrative history.
expected: Subsequent submissions using the disabled key are rejected.
Previously accepted records remain retained.
The disabling identity/time/outcome are recorded.

cases.title: Disable an authorized workspace key as SA-A
cases.preconditions: SA-A has the agreed disabling permission; a valid A key and an accepted A transaction exist.
steps: Disable the A key.
Send a fresh valid transaction using the disabled key.
Inspect the earlier accepted transaction and administrative history.
expected: Subsequent submissions using the disabled key are rejected.
Previously accepted records remain retained.
The disabling identity/time/outcome are recorded.

cases.title: Replace a key using the approved rotation policy
cases.preconditions: A is active with an old valid key; an authorized issuer can replace it. The approved connection/key design specifies replacement and any overlap; no overlap duration is assumed.
steps: Replace the key through an authorized issuer.
Test new/old keys using the approved replacement policy; test overlap only if that policy permits it.
Disable the old key and submit independent transactions with each key.
expected: Replacement is A-scoped and follows the approved key invalidation policy.
After revocation the old key fails; the valid replacement works.
No stored old secret is retrievable.

cases.title: Keep full keys out of logs and ordinary audit history
cases.preconditions: The isolated environment permits authorized inspection of generated-key output and logs.
steps: Issue and disable a runtime-generated test key.
Inspect ordinary key detail, audit records and application logs for the complete value.
expected: Only the authorized one-time disclosure contains the full new key.
Stored verification/metadata and logs do not expose the original secret.

cases.title: Configure declared standard/custom fields and channel mappings
cases.preconditions: STAFF-A is assigned; TEST-MAP-A is the explicitly declared synthetic workspace configuration. Configuration edits are candidate drafts; production uses only an explicitly applied version.
steps: Declare the test fields with types, requiredness and sensitivity.
Map the REST, incoming Webhook and file formats to those fields.
Save and inspect the active configured format for each channel.
expected: Approved mappings resolve to the same internal field meanings.
One active format exists per channel and CSV/Excel share the file-import channel.
This test configuration does not introduce a product-wide required-field contract.

cases.title: Reject invalid field/operator/mapping conversions
cases.preconditions: STAFF-A is assigned and declared fields include numeric, text and Boolean types. Configuration edits are candidate drafts; production uses only an explicitly applied version.
steps: Attempt an incompatible mapping conversion or unsupported field reference.
Attempt to configure a text/list operator on an incompatible numeric/Boolean field.
Inspect the saved active configuration.
expected: The invalid configuration is rejected with safe actionable details.
The last valid active configuration remains usable.

cases.title: Normalize corresponding inputs to the same meanings
cases.preconditions: TEST-MAP-A defines each input format; use fresh isolated transaction identities or separate runs to avoid duplicate interference. Configuration edits are candidate drafts; production uses only an explicitly applied version.
steps: Submit equivalent business values separately through each configured channel.
Compare the permitted normalized values and selected rule/configuration context.
expected: Corresponding fields have the same declared normalized meanings across channels.
Channel differences do not select a different workspace rule set.

cases.title: Evaluate numeric 'equal' at a known boundary
cases.preconditions: Assigned Staff has configured a single active numeric comparison against 1000000 in TEST-MAP-A. Configuration edits are candidate drafts; production uses only an explicitly applied version.
steps: Set the numeric comparison to 'equal' with threshold 1000000.
Evaluate a sample whose amount is 1000000.
Inspect the matched-condition result.
expected: The rule matches according to the configured comparison.
No normalized risk points or severity are produced.

cases.title: Evaluate numeric 'not equal' at a known boundary
cases.preconditions: Assigned Staff has configured a single active numeric comparison against 1000000 in TEST-MAP-A. Configuration edits are candidate drafts; production uses only an explicitly applied version.
steps: Set the numeric comparison to 'not equal' with threshold 1000000.
Evaluate a sample whose amount is 999999.
Inspect the matched-condition result.
expected: The rule matches according to the configured comparison.
No normalized risk points or severity are produced.

cases.title: Evaluate numeric 'greater than' at a known boundary
cases.preconditions: Assigned Staff has configured a single active numeric comparison against 1000000 in TEST-MAP-A. Configuration edits are candidate drafts; production uses only an explicitly applied version.
steps: Set the numeric comparison to 'greater than' with threshold 1000000.
Evaluate a sample whose amount is 1000000.
Inspect the matched-condition result.
expected: The rule does not match according to the configured comparison.
No normalized risk points or severity are produced.

cases.title: Evaluate numeric 'greater than or equal' at a known boundary
cases.preconditions: Assigned Staff has configured a single active numeric comparison against 1000000 in TEST-MAP-A. Configuration edits are candidate drafts; production uses only an explicitly applied version.
steps: Set the numeric comparison to 'greater than or equal' with threshold 1000000.
Evaluate a sample whose amount is 1000000.
Inspect the matched-condition result.
expected: The rule matches according to the configured comparison.
No normalized risk points or severity are produced.

cases.title: Evaluate numeric 'less than' at a known boundary
cases.preconditions: Assigned Staff has configured a single active numeric comparison against 1000000 in TEST-MAP-A. Configuration edits are candidate drafts; production uses only an explicitly applied version.
steps: Set the numeric comparison to 'less than' with threshold 1000000.
Evaluate a sample whose amount is 1000000.
Inspect the matched-condition result.
expected: The rule does not match according to the configured comparison.
No normalized risk points or severity are produced.

cases.title: Evaluate numeric 'less than or equal' at a known boundary
cases.preconditions: Assigned Staff has configured a single active numeric comparison against 1000000 in TEST-MAP-A. Configuration edits are candidate drafts; production uses only an explicitly applied version.
steps: Set the numeric comparison to 'less than or equal' with threshold 1000000.
Evaluate a sample whose amount is 1000000.
Inspect the matched-condition result.
expected: The rule matches according to the configured comparison.
No normalized risk points or severity are produced.

cases.title: Evaluate declared text/list and Boolean conditions
cases.preconditions: TEST-MAP-A declares device_type as text and is_remote as Boolean. Configuration edits are candidate drafts; production uses only an explicitly applied version.
steps: Test a text equality and a list-membership condition using declared sample values.
Test true and false Boolean values.
Compare each output with the configured condition.
expected: Text/list conditions and Boolean conditions use their supported types/operators.
Incompatible coercions are not silently accepted.

cases.title: Evaluate non-nested AND and OR correctly
cases.preconditions: Two independently controllable conditions are configured without nesting. Configuration edits are candidate drafts; production uses only an explicitly applied version.
steps: Evaluate samples with both conditions true, one true and neither true using AND.
Repeat the same samples using OR.
expected: AND matches only when both conditions are true.
OR matches when at least one condition is true.
The matched reasons identify the conditions actually satisfied.

cases.title: Reject nested groups or arbitrary executable rule content
cases.preconditions: STAFF-A is authenticated and can edit A's rule configuration. Configuration edits are candidate drafts; production uses only an explicitly applied version.
steps: Attempt a nested condition structure that is outside the confirmed rule scope.
Submit executable text/code as if it were a rule definition.
expected: Unsupported structures/content are rejected.
No supplied code is executed and the valid configuration remains unchanged.

cases.title: Do not match ordinary comparisons on an absent optional value
cases.preconditions: The optional test note field is absent; ordinary not-equal and not-in-list conditions are configured. Configuration edits are candidate drafts; production uses only an explicitly applied version.
steps: Evaluate not-equal against a nonempty literal.
Evaluate not-in-list against a supplied list.
expected: Neither ordinary comparison matches the absent optional value.
Absence is not treated as a business value that satisfies exclusion comparisons.

cases.title: Detect an absent optional field only with the explicit empty condition
cases.preconditions: The test mapping declares note optional and the sample omits it. Configuration edits are candidate drafts; production uses only an explicitly applied version.
steps: Evaluate the explicit has-no-value condition.
Repeat using has-value.
expected: Has-no-value matches the absent optional field.
Has-value does not match that field.

cases.title: Ignore disabled rules and aggregate all active matches
cases.preconditions: A has two active matching rules and one disabled rule that would otherwise match. Configuration edits are candidate drafts; production uses only an explicitly applied version.
steps: Evaluate one fresh production transaction that matches both active rules.
Inspect Rule Alerts and detection reasons.
